notes.title: Star Wars™ Pinball VR is finally here! Get on the leaderboards today!
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball Pals!

Check out our brand new game, Star Wars™ Pinball VR, which is now available to play on Steam VR! Jump into a galaxy far, far away once again, and immerse yourself in virtual reality pinball!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1530770?utm_source=steam&utm_medium_PFX2VR

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/6eddff33588b7825bf28612e0254176a9a861244.png


 The “Fan Cave”: The new home for your pinball table, plus the customizable array of Star Wars lightsabers, blasters, helmets, and more you’ll earn while playing. Start up a new table and life-sized characters and vehicles join you on either side.
 The Mandalorian: The excitement of the first season translated into VR pinball goodness. Take bounties, protect the Child, and meet characters like IG-11 or Moff Gideon. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/542fed09cc0927bf1b1c2cf59df30aa80614ea3f.png


 Total Immersion Mode: Stand side-by-side with your favorite characters and experience everything at table level.
 Full 360-Degree Mini-Games: Dive into iconic Star Wars set pieces like the speeder bike chase on Endor, the Bespin carbon-freezing chamber duel, and others.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39942376/caccc229c3c425bbafe53f7506d140e3034fd75d.png


 Career Mode: Play bite-sized challenges designed to make you a better player! Progress through missions, and become the ultimate pinball wizard. 


In addition, enjoy classic Star Wars™ Pinball features like Force powers, competitive gameplay, haptic controller feedback, your own personal cantina jukebox, and more!

The only thing you need to do now is don your VR headset, press play, and start getting those jackpots! 

The Zen Team

notes.title: Pinball FX2 VR and its DLCs are up to 60% off!
notes.content:
Hey VR Pinball fans!

This week, we decided to bring discounts to the VR platform also, so you can get the base game 60% off with three original Zen tables, however you can also get every DLC on a discounted price!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/547590/Pinball_FX2_VR/

First, the Season 1 Pack: Experience five fan-favorite tables recreated for virtual reality! Storm the gates of your enemy’s castle with Sir Gareth on the “CastleStorm” table, take part in a true western showdown in “Wild West Rampage,” achieve groundbreaking scientific results in “BioLab,” investigate a series of supernatural events in “Paranormal,” and repel the invading alien forces in “Earth Defense”!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/549070/Pinball_FX2_VR__Season_1_Pack/

The Walking Dead: Take a tour of the most iconic locations from Telltale’s classic adventure game, including the St. John’s Dairy Farm, Traveller Motel, Bell Tower, RV and more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/549071/Pinball_FX2_VR__The_Walking_Dead/

Join the adventure and relive the most captivating moments from three timeless blockbuster films in Universal Classics™ Pinball.

- Go behind the wheel of the DeLorean time machine and help Marty and Doc fix the space-time continuum as they travel through the many eras of Hill Valley on the Back to the Future™ Pinball table.
- Take down the terrifying great white shark threatening Amity Island or turn the tides in several thrilling game modes on the Jaws™ Pinball table.
- Help E.T. and his friend Elliott contact E.T.’s spacecraft and return to the stars on the E.T.™ Pinball table.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865320/Pinball_FX2_VR__Universal_Classics_Pinball/

That’s all for the week, enjoy these masterpieces in (almost) full reality!

Linne

notes.title: The Pinball FX2 Ultimate Edition
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We have some great news for you: if you ever wanted to dive into the breathtaking world of Pinball FX2 VR, Christmas came early for you! Let us introduce the Pinball FX2 VR Ultimate Edition, a package of Zen's greatest original tables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26935726/9c1c12eaa2b3e1b9e28149d0a33646d89d2b0da9.png

Let's see what this edition has to offer:

- Base Game: Dive deep into the ocean, surrounded by creatures of the depths in “Secrets of the Deep,” embark on a journey in a classical fantasy setting, accompanied by a friendly knight in “Epic Quest,” or lead humanity to a new frontier and help mankind explore “Mars”!

https://i.imgur.com/OQoKps0.gif

- Season 1 Pack: Experience five fan-favorite tables recreated for virtual reality! Storm the gates of your enemy’s castle with Sir Gareth on the “CastleStorm” table, take part in a true western showdown in “Wild West Rampage,” achieve groundbreaking scientific results in “BioLab,” investigate a series of supernatural events in “Paranormal,” and repel the invading alien forces in “Earth Defense”!

https://i.imgur.com/IGKS9Di.jpg

Sounds great, doesn't it?

If VR Pinball is on your bucket list, this is Christmas in early November: grab the Pinball FX2 Ultimate Edition!

See you on the (virtual) leaderboards!
